task.title: P6-026: Add aria-disabled and typeahead to ContextMenuItem; coordinate ESC via overlay stack
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 7 — UX, a11y and visual, Accessibility). Original id: P6-026. Size: M. Specs: specs/ui-components.md.

**`ContextMenuItem` has no `aria-disabled` and no typeahead, and the menu's ESC is still not coordinated through the overlay stack.** All three pre-existing (`context_menu.rs:459` has no `disabled` prop; zero typeahead references; the module doc at `:28-29` records ESC as "not overlay-stack-coordinated — same known caveat as popover"), and all three now more visible because the tree-move task made the menu keyboard-operable for the first time.
